penz_home3_jory.text: We call summer visitors emmets. It means ant in Cornish. Do not take offence. We love them, mostly.
My dad was a tin miner. He believed in the knockers, little folk who tapped the rock. He left them a bit of pasty crust.
Gannets dive off this coast from up to 30 metres, folding their wings at the last moment. Eat your heart out, Olympics.
